description: A local Go CLI and optional AI skill for creating, validating, maintaining, reviewing, translating, and publishing verifiable Markdown project documentation.
rules: In user repositories, use the installed `toudocu` binary. Use `go run ./cmd/toudocu` only inside the Toudocu source repository.
Treat `toudocu ...` as shell CLI and `$toudocu ...` as AI-skill workflows. `init`, `refresh`, `translate`, and `feedback` are not top-level CLI commands.
Before changing documentation, follow the target repository's instructions and `.toudocu/config.yml`; reuse its canonical docs root, repository root, excludes, locale, and output.
Do not invoke `$toudocu init`, `$toudocu refresh`, `$toudocu translate`, `$toudocu feedback`, or `task verify --run` implicitly; they require explicit user intent.
A successful `toudocu check` proves structural contracts and declared relationships, not semantic truth. Never invent facts, status, dates, or relationships to clear diagnostics.
Choose a document type by the reader question it answers; use ordinary Markdown when stable IDs, validated relationships, or special presentation are unnecessary.
Use canonical documentation as the operational source of truth. Translation roots are read-only mirrors during ordinary work and change only through an explicit translation workflow.
Use `toudocu serve` for local editable work and `toudocu build` for read-only static HTTP(S) publication. `file://` is not a supported portal contract.
For `$toudocu feedback`, process only deliveries returned by `toudocu agent next --json`; do not discover unrelated work or run check, tests, lint, or build.
